verdict.rationale: Datadog documents 'Bits AI' as a built-in AI assistant (datadog-docs-4), which aligns with delegating tasks like incident investigation or monitor creation inside the product, but the evidence pack only lists the doc title/URL with no detail on task-delegation scope, autonomy, or hands-on validation. Missing for 10: detailed capability description of Bits AI's task delegation, independent/hands-on confirmation of it acting autonomously.
